method_glossary.Assignment ARI: state-assignment adjusted Rand index; not within-edge AUROC
method_glossary.Forced hard: forced_hard: candidate hard maps regardless of gate decision
method_glossary.Gated hard: native_hard / STCG-v1: gate-returned hard maps; rejection emits the constant window-maximum map
method_glossary.Pooled AUROC: AUROC pooled over nonself edge/window entries, formerly temporal_graph_auroc / T-AUROC
method_glossary.Raw fallback: same gate and accepted candidate as native_hard; rejection emits raw window scores
method_glossary.Within-edge AUROC: mean active/inactive-window AUROC on evaluable changing nonself edges, formerly temporal_delta_auroc / T-AUC_delta / State AUROC
